head: src/margin_reader.py
commit_title: feat: add optional sub-department column read
intent: This change will read the A&L sub-department from the margin report row. Nothing else in the repository changes.

issues.title: A missing column silently becomes a legitimate value
issues.description: read_subdepartment returns "" when the ZB61 column is missing, which downstream code reads as the legitimate "000 = None" sub-department, so column drift corrupts data without an error.
